culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Marae are sacred: adopt a respectful, quiet attitude and leave no rubbish. Don't climb on structures for photos.
culture-and-protocol.sacred_or_restricted_places: On marae and other archaeological sites: stay on marked paths, don't climb on or move stones, don't touch the tiki (ti'i). Fires, alcohol, picnics, pets and graffiti are prohibited.
culture-and-protocol.note: Territory-wide marae guidance applied to the island group. Tiki and paepae such as those at Hatiheu (Nuku Hiva).

sources.title: 10 things you didn't know about Tahitian culture
